name: pure-lust-kpop-bad-girl-comeback
image_vibe: Ethereal glossy K-pop comeback styling with soft bloom, height-chart graphics, and confident dark fashion
image_purpose: Create a high-end K-pop-inspired album-cover or fashion campaign portrait.

prompt.project_info: A 2:3 high-end K-pop-inspired beauty portrait of an original adult Korean fashion performer against a clean studio height chart.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult Korean woman with delicate facial features, natural realistic skin texture, long straight black hair with see-through bangs, gradient lip makeup, glitter eye makeup, and a confident composed editorial gaze. She wears a form-fitting black latex bodysuit with softened studio highlights, a strapless neckline, a silver choker, and a diamond-studded handcuff-inspired fashion bracelet as a decorative accessory. She stands like a fashion model against the height chart.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait-oriented 2:3 framing, subject standing against minimalist height-chart lines on a white or light-gray wall, one hand playing with her hair and the other holding a slate board reading 'BAD GIRL' with date 'COMEBACK', centered album-cover hierarchy, and clear face/fashion focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Overexposed soft studio lighting with controlled bloom and halo light around the subject, dreamy ethereal atmosphere, realistic skin and latex reflections, clean bright background, and polished K-pop beauty-campaign finish.
prompt.technical_specs: 2:3 portrait composition, photorealistic beauty photography, 85mm lens, f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic skin, hair, latex, metal, and slate texture, subtle film grain, soft highlight bloom, high-resolution clarity, no extra text or watermark beyond the specified slate.
